title: Fed Beige Book (pre-FOMC edition for the June 8-9 2027 SEP meeting), 2:00 p.m. ET
source: EST: rule-derived from federalreserve.gov primaries re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 by this event's own initial research, because the Board has posted no 2027 Beige Book schedule at all. THE RULE IS RE-MEASURED HERE, NOT INHERITED, AND THE INHERITED FORM WAS WRONG. The proposal that discovered this event asserted 'decision day minus 14 days', reproduced 8 of 8 against 2026. Measured across every Beige Book the Board publishes an archive page for -- 129 editions 2007-2026, release dates parsed out of the archive's own three URL conventions (BeigeBook_YYYYMMDD.pdf, /fomc/beigebook/YYYY/YYYYMMDD/, fullreport YYYYMMDD.pdf) and paired against 107 FOMC meetings parsed from fomccalendars.htm plus all fourteen fomchistorical<year>.htm pages 2007-2020 -- decision-day-minus-14 holds only 88 of 107 (82.2%). THE ACTUAL INVARIANT: all 129 releases are a WEDNESDAY, without exception, and the edition is the Wednesday of the second week before the meeting's own week, which holds 107 of 107 (the one apparent miss is a parse artefact of the Board's own 'May 30-1' rendering of the April 30 - May 1 2019 meeting; corrected, it fits). The two formulations agree here only because June 8-9 2027 is a Tuesday-Wednesday meeting. THE MEETING: fomccalendars.htm re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, footer 'Last Update: August 19, 2026'), whose 2027 panel reads verbatim 'January 26-27 | March 16-17* | April 27-28 | June 8-9* | July 27-28 | September 14-15* | October 26-27 | December 7-8*' with the footnote '* Meeting associated with a Summary of Economic Projections.' -- so June 8-9 carries an SEP. Meeting week begins Monday 2027-06-07; two weeks earlier is the week of 2027-05-24; its Wednesday is 2027-05-26, weekday verified. THE TIME: 2:00 p.m. ET, read off a Board month page rather than assumed -- newsevents/2026-september.htm (fetched direct 2026-09-09) carries a Beige Book block reading 'Time: 2:00 p.m. | Release Date(s): 2'. FILED ESTIMATE ON THREE COUNTS, none of which is doubt about the arithmetic: beige-book-default.htm was re-fetched 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 86,202 bytes) and still carries NO 2027 editions -- its list ends at the 2026 set (Jan 14, Mar 4, Apr 15, Jun 3, Jul 15, Sep 2, Oct 14, Nov 25); federalreserve.gov/newsevents/2027-may.htm and /2027-june.htm both returned 404; and the same fomccalendars.htm states 'Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it', so the underlying June meeting is itself tentative until the 2027-04-27/28 meeting ratifies it. The promotion trigger is the Board posting its 2027 Beige Book schedule, or newsevents/2027-may.htm appearing. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by the beige-book-2027-05-26 initial-research lane (2026-09-09) after reading the one prior proposal, proposals/beige-book-2027-05-26.from-fomc-minutes-2027-05-19.json, which is now inert. THE PROPOSAL FOUND THE RIGHT DATE BY A RULE THAT IS WRONG 18% OF THE TIME -- see source above; the corrected Wednesday-anchored form holds 107 of 107 and lands on the same day here, so the date survives a stronger test than the one that produced it. WHAT THIS EDITION IS: the last Beige Book the June 2027 dot plot ever sees, and it lands three days before the gate. Corridor, all dated: April-meeting minutes 2027-05-19 (fomc-minutes-2027-05-19, estimate) -> THIS 14:00 ET Wednesday 2027-05-26 -> SIFMA-recommended 2:00 p.m. ET fixed-income close Friday 2027-05-28 (sifma-bond-early-close-2027-05-28, estimate) -> blackout opens 12:00 a.m. Saturday 2027-05-29 through 2027-06-10 (fomc-blackout-start-2027-05-29, estimate) -> Memorial Day closure Monday 2027-05-31 -> FOMC + SEP 2027-06-09. Exactly TWO equity sessions separate the release from the gate, one of them a truncated bond session. WHO WRITES IT IS PREDICTABLE AND IS REGISTERED AS A FORWARD TEST: the preparing Reserve Bank rotates on an exact 12-District cycle -- Richmond, Cleveland, New York, Kansas City, Chicago, Minneapolis, Atlanta, St. Louis, Boston, Philadelphia, San Francisco, Dallas -- unbroken across the 18 consecutive editions 2024-07-17 through 2026-09-02, each preparer read off that edition's own national summary. Nine steps on from Minneapolis (2026-09-02) puts DALLAS on this edition, which matters because the preparer writes the national summary's framing and Dallas's District is the centre of the ERCOT data-center and power build-out our AI-infra sleeve tracks. IMPACT STAYS LOW, AGAINST THE SIBLING 2026 ENTRIES' MEDIUM, AND THE REASON IS MEASURED RATHER THAN INHERITED: across 128 Beige Book Wednesdays vs 888 matched non-Beige-Book Wednesdays 2007-2026 (^GSPC daily bars, fetched fresh 2026-09-09), the only significant elevation is the OVERNIGHT gap that precedes the 14:00 release (0.268% vs 0.198%, ratio 1.35, permutation p=0.016), while the session that actually contains the release shows nothing (open-to-close 0.770% vs 0.690%, ratio 1.12, p=0.31). A 2:00 p.m. release cannot cause a gap that opened at 09:30, so the marginal close-to-close elevation (p=0.07) is calendar clustering, not the release. Estimate widens caution only and licenses nothing; symbols is empty and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is macro-keyed.
